headline: Trilegal advises Bodhi Tree Systems on $180 million majority stake acquisition in Adyar Anand Bhavan

detail: Bodhi Tree Systems has made an investment of $180 million to acquire a majority stake in Adyar Ananda Bhavan Sweets India Private Limited (A2B), one of the leading QSR chains in southern India. Trilegal advised Bodhi Tree Systems on all aspects of the transaction, including legal due diligence, transaction structuring, leading the preparation and negotiation of the transaction documents and closing of the transaction. The transaction was led by Sanjam Arora (Partner) and Vishal Sagar (Partner), who were supported by Niharika Choudhary (Counsel), Anisha Bhattacharjee (Counsel), Associates Anadi Singh, Kashish Khandelwal, Akshat Kabra, Vagmita Tiwari and Shikhar Srivastava.
